description: This file defines the InlineLoanCOBExecutionDataParser class, which is responsible for parsing JSON data related to loan execution within the context of the Charge-Off Basket (COB) process in the Fineract system. It interacts with JSON commands and extracts loan IDs from provided JSON structures.

classes.name: InlineLoanCOBExecutionDataParser
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for parsing JSON commands to extract a list of loan IDs relevant to COB (Charge-Off Basket) processing.

methods.name: parseExecution
methods.description: Extracts the array of loan IDs from a given JsonCommand and converts it into a list of Longs.

methods.name: extractJsonObject
methods.description: Parses the JSON string from the JsonCommand and converts it into a JsonObject, throwing an exception if the JSON is blank or invalid.
